# Vera — The AI Engineer That Works While You Don't

> Vera is an autonomous AI engineering agent embedded in Slack, Linear, and GitHub. Delegate tasks via DM — wake up to merged PRs.

Vera operates on a 5-stage lifecycle: Research, Prep/Plan, Execute, Review, and Triage. It works asynchronously — handling your backlog while you're in meetings, on the road, or asleep. Built by Agent Army, Vera is the async AI engineering agent for teams that ship fast.

## Pages

- [Home](https://agent-army.ai/): Landing page with product overview, lifecycle, use cases, and integrations
- [Full Product Description](https://agent-army.ai/llms-full.txt): Complete feature descriptions, use cases, and technical details

## Product

- Name: Vera
- Category: AI Engineering Agent
- Platforms: Slack, Linear, GitHub
- Built by: Agent Army

## Capabilities

- Research: Deep-dive codebase and web research for feature planning
- Prep/Plan: Break down tickets, validate sizing, enrich context
- Execute: Implement features, open PRs, write tests
- Review: Code review, resolve merge conflicts, keep CI green
- Triage: Investigate bugs, identify root cause, implement fixes

## Use Cases

- [Feature Research & Implementation](https://agent-army.ai/#use-cases): Turn ideas into implementation-ready specs and merged PRs
- [Backlog Triage & Bug Fixes](https://agent-army.ai/#use-cases): Clear your backlog while you sleep
- [Codebase Audits](https://agent-army.ai/#use-cases): Security, scalability, and anti-pattern detection
- [Market Research to Shipped Code](https://agent-army.ai/#use-cases): From competitive analysis to shipped code
- [Autonomous Backlog Processing](https://agent-army.ai/#use-cases): An engineer that never stops shipping

## Integrations

- [Slack](https://agent-army.ai/#integrations): Delegate tasks via DM. Progress updates in threads.
- [Linear](https://agent-army.ai/#integrations): Assign tickets directly. Vera moves them through your workflow.
- [GitHub](https://agent-army.ai/#integrations): Automated pull requests, review comments, and iteration.

## Technical

- [Architecture](https://agent-army.ai/#architecture): Multi-agent system with codebase understanding, structured workflows, and BYOK support.
- [Full Product Description](https://agent-army.ai/llms-full.txt): Complete technical details, competitive positioning, and FAQ.

## Differentiators

Vera occupies a unique position in the AI coding tools landscape:
- **vs. IDE copilots** (Cursor, Copilot): Vera is async — no IDE required, no babysitting needed.
- **vs. Standalone agents** (Devin): Vera is embedded in Slack/Linear/GitHub — no new workspace.
- **vs. CI/review bots** (CodeRabbit, Greptile): Full engineering lifecycle, not just code review.

Primary keywords: AI engineering agent, async AI engineer, AI coding agent Slack, autonomous coding agent.
